title: McDonald’s taps former McKinsey partner to lead U.S. strategy overhaul - Bloomberg
summary: Investing.com -- McDonald’s Corporation (NYSE:MCD) has appointed former McKinsey & Co. partner Hannah Yankelevich as its new U.S. vice president of strategy, intensifying a leadership overhaul aimed at reversing sluggish domestic demand. Effective December 1, Yankelevich will lead the fast-food giant’s U.S. strategic insights and prioritization team, replacing eight-year company veteran Mike Shapiro, according to an internal email reviewed by Bloomberg News.
